title: Rework palette modes, scale stepper and shadow lattice for interactive data-visualizations
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Dense dashboards and interactive charts are exhibiting visual noise and inconsistent emphasis across themes. Current token ramps were created for static surfaces and don't scale well for layered dataviz (lines, fills, overlays, interactive hover states). Typography scale increments feel large in compact tables and small controls; radius steps lead to awkward button/tile shapes at different breakpoints. Shadows are either too harsh or too flat when multiple elevation layers overlap in charts and floating panels.

Goal: Introduce a cohesive token update that: 1) provides a palette-mode strategy (base, elevated, overlay) optimized for layered charts; 2) implements a fine-grained typography stepper tuned for dense tables and micro-controls; 3) defines a variable-radius delta system so buttons, chips and table cells scale proportionally across breakpoints; 4) replaces current shadow tokens with a "shadow lattice" (composable micro-shadows) to reduce visual noise and improve perceived depth in overlapping contexts.

This ticket covers the design spec, accessibility checks, and migration guidance for component owners (buttons, tables, charts, controls). Engineering tasks (token release, codemods) will be tracked as dependent ENG tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec published with token mappings for light/dark/high-contrast modes and clear guidance for layered charts
Typography stepper defined with values for Compact / Default / Spacious density and documented impact on forms, tables, and buttons
Radius delta system documented with CSS variable examples and target component updates for primary/secondary buttons and table cells
Shadow lattice primitives defined (3 micro-shadow layers) with examples showing overlapping panels and chart overlays that maintain contrast and legibility
A migration checklist and codemod guidance exists so engineering can perform safe token swaps without visual regressions
Accessibility: All new color ramps meet AA for normal text and WCAG contrast patterns documented for chart stroke/fill pairs
rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize token matrix and hand off to platform design review (this ticket)
Week 2: Create detailed component adaptation guides for Buttons, Table rows, Chart layers; UX review with Component owners
Week 3: Engineering PRs for token variables and initial codemod scripts (ENG dependency) — staging rollout on staging-console
Week 4: Visual QA pass across top 10 dashboards, accessibility audit, iterate on edge cases
Week 5: Canary release behind feature flag + monitor console metrics and regression screenshots
Full release: Flip flag, publish migration guide and deprecation timeline for old tokens
migration_steps: Create mapping table: old_token -> new_token with rationale (contrast, density, elevation context)
Ship new CSS variables in tokens package under a 1.0-compatible namespace to avoid breaking imports
Expose radius-delta utility helper and update button mixins to accept delta tokens
Add chart-layer token adapter helpers (fill/line/hover) to charting primitives repo
Run codemod to replace top-level token imports in components and generate PRs for component owners
Coordinate with ENG to create visual diff tests for the most trafficked dashboards
notes: Decision: prefer composable micro-shadows over single heavy drop-shadow to improve legibility when overlays stack; see design rationale section in Confluence
Trade-off: introducing radius-delta increases variable surface math complexity for components but reduces bespoke radii across codebase
UX feedback from initial run: legend chips need a dedicated contrast token to remain tappable in compact density
Follow-up: schedule a cross-team sync (Design + Charts + Platform) to review codemod PRs before landing
